title: the runner, turn after turn
line: the runner takes in what was saved first, then the queue's first person, runs their turn with the network standing in, names them again and passes them over once their turn held nothing new, runs the next person, whose turn leaves pages to save in the browser, and goes on past him to the next: he waits, his entry kept beside the database, and the queue passes him over with the number of pages; a fresh run while he waits is not refused, starts the count again, and passes him over the same way

steps.say: the home person's parents confirmed on the owner's word, so the queue names the home person's own open question, then the grandparents
three turns: the home person's holds nothing new and the queue names him again, so he is passed over; the grandfather's leaves two pages to save in the browser, and the run goes on to the grandmother
